anomalies.description: A man in a yellow shirt points a handgun directly at another man holding a microphone; the gun is clearly visible and aimed, constituting visual evidence of an imminent or ongoing shooting.

After the gun is pointed, the man with the microphone raises his hands and appears to be struck or pushed back; the man in yellow remains extended forward, and a third person (in cap) turns toward the interaction, indicating physical confrontation or assault.; The man in the white shirt (previously holding a mic) appears to strike or push the man in the yellow shirt, who recoils; physical contact is implied by posture and motion blur, indicating mutual or one-sided physical combat.

Multiple individuals flee down the hallway while the man in white reacts defensively; chaotic movement, camera operator repositioning, and group dispersal suggest collective violent unrest following the initial shooting and fighting.
